title: Night Express
composition: Original sixteen-bar instrumental composition created for this project. No external recordings, melodies, or sound effects used.
music: Sample-style reed lead, plucked arpeggios, soft string pad, bass, and drums. Original notes and arrangement; circular short-room delays.
effects: Original damped modal synthesis of wood and metal bodies with deterministic noise transients.
validation: PCM source peak 0.82, RMS 0.1441, zero source loop-edge difference. Subjective sound quality still requires listening.
